name: web-material-style-ui-kit-with-type-colours-forms-cards-and-lists
title: Material-Style UI Kit Overview
whatItIs: A pale board of white panels showing a UI kit: Inter headings H1 to H6, a colour palette (blue, green, red, yellow, magenta gradient), application bars, a news feed with a green nav bar, a checkout stepper, checkboxes and radios, buttons, form controls, cards in light and dark variants and menu and list items.
whatItMeans: Showing every component category in tiles on one board gives a complete overview of the system in a familiar Material style.
techniques: Primary colours as coloured square swatches
Light and dark variants of cards

vocabulary.definition: A list of heading and body styles from H1 downward.
A bar at the top of a screen with title and actions.
A component showing progress through numbered steps.
